title: Three Saturdays and One Short Brush
subtitle: 手工工艺 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 手工工艺（人与社会·艺术与工艺·手工与制作）
meta: 主题语境：手工工艺（人与社会·艺术与工艺·手工与制作）　|　核心词汇：glue　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 glue 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the restorer ① mixed the glue that no apprentice in the workshop would have described, and he said the mixing was the whole of the Saturday. The ② glue, meaning the paste itself and not the varnish, ran three Saturdays and stayed undescribed in the book; glue, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ pot of glue in that workshop had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ glue at the far bench, meaning the pot they kept for the children's models and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Glue, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the restorer said the describing is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the glue was the whole of the matter, meaning the bond and not the paste. The ⑥ glue, meaning the bond and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; glue, he said, is either something you mix or the only word that means both a paste and a bond. He said the bond is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ glue had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ glue of the whole thing, the restorer wrote in November, was one workshop and three Saturdays of describing; glue, he said, is either the pot at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ glue I remember is the glue described in the list, which closed in 1983 and is still described as the quietest in the workshop. ⑩ Glue, my mother said in 1985, is the only paste that improves by being described; all glue, she said, is a bond that has agreed to look like a paste. She said the bond was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 胶；胶水（指工坊里每一罐旁边的那一罐）
B. n. 胶；胶水（指那些胶本身，与清漆相对）
C. 固定搭配：mix the glue 调胶
D. n. 胶水（指留给孩子们做模型的那一罐）
E. n. 胶（抽象总称，指一间工坊的用胶之事）
F. n. 胶（指清单里写到、被记下的那些）
G. n. 纽带；黏合之力（指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联结（抽象总称，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: mixed the glue that no apprentice in the workshop would have described
The glue, meaning the paste itself and not the varnish
Every pot of glue in that workshop
the glue at the far bench
the glue was the whole of the matter
the glue had become a line in a list
The glue of the whole thing

answers.why: mix the glue 意为“调胶”，1976 年那位修复师调了工坊里没有一位学徒肯描述的一罐胶水。
glue 意为“胶、胶水”，指那些胶本身而不是清漆，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被描述。
glue 意为“胶、胶水”，指工坊里每一罐旁边的那一罐，每一罐旁边都有同一把矮矮的刷子。
glue 意为“胶水”，指最远那张长凳上留给孩子们做模型的那一罐，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
glue 意为“纽带、联结之力”，指一件事里人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份联结就是那件事的全部。
glue 意为“联结”，指人人都靠却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些胶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
glue 意为“胶”，指清单里写到、被记下的那些，到 1981 年这些成了清单里的一行。
glue 意为“胶”，修复师十一月写道，整件事的用胶之事是一间工坊和三个星期六的描述。
glue 意为“胶”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那些，1983 年用完了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一批。
glue 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，胶水是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
